truths.truth: Over the committed fixture corpus, `planning.mjs recall` returns the same document set for seam/seams, close/closes, file/files, note/notes and type/types
truths.evidence: Ran the real CLI against a root materialized from cadence-core/bin/fixtures/recall.corpus.json: `seam` and `seams` both total=2 ids=zq02,zq01; `close` and `closes` both total=2 ids=zq03,zq04. The seam arm cadence-core/bin/planning-recall-fold.test.mjs:248-277 deep-equals `results` and equals `total` across all 8 groups AND asserts each other member's exclusive document id is in the hits (docWithWord at :241 fails unless exactly one fixture doc carries the literal word), so a group cannot pass on shared literal terms; `node --test cadence-core/bin/planning-recall-fold.test.mjs` = 12/12 pass. Tokenizer level: tokenize('seams')/tokenize('seam') both ['seam'], closes/close both ['close'], files/file both ['file'], notes/note both ['note'], types/type both ['type'].

truths.truth: name, named and naming return the same document set, and so do refuse/refused and plan/planned
truths.evidence: CLI probe over the fixture root: `name`, `named` and `naming` each total=3 ids=zq12,zq11,zq13. Same GROUPS arm (planning-recall-fold.test.mjs:229-277) covers refuse/refused and plan/planned with deep-equal results, equal total, non-empty guard at :260, and the other-member's-document arm at :270-273. tokenize: named/naming/name -> ['name'], refused/refuse -> ['refuse'], planned/plan -> ['plan']. The rule table pins the load-bearing branch (`refused` -> `refuse`, planning-recall-fold.test.mjs:199) that the textbook m==1 gate would break.

truths.truth: The fold never deletes a term by landing it on a stopword: the stopword filter still tests the raw token
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/lib/bm25.mjs:157-163 - `.filter((t) => t && !STOPWORDS.has(t)).map(foldSuffix)`, filter strictly before the fold, with the measured reason in the docstring at :148-155. Falsifiable arm at planning-recall-fold.test.mjs:290-301: for `being` and `its` it asserts the word is NOT itself a stopword, that its FOLD IS in STOPWORDS, and that buildIndex([word]).df.get(term) === 1 - only possible if the filter ran first. Reverse guard at :314-322 (a stopword-only text tokenizes to [] and yields df.size 0), so the arms cannot be satisfied by a filter that stopped running. At the seam, CLI probe: `notes` total=2 (zq07,zq08), `being` total=1 (zq18).

truths.truth: A committed fixture query set names its known-good top hits, runs under the suite, and its named hits hold except the entries marked changed_by_fold
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/fixtures/recall.queries.json holds 16 entries; recall.corpus.json holds 30 documents over 4 sources and 3 corpus tiers (phases/1/SUMMARY.md 8, phases/2/CONTEXT.md 8, CAPTURE.md 8, phases/3/SUMMARY.md 6), exceeding the plan's 24-doc / 3-source floor. The baseline was committed BEFORE the fold (537caa66) and `git diff 537caa66 1d6a10ac -- recall.queries.json` touches exactly 2 of 16 entries (2 insertions, 2 deletions), each carrying a changed_by_fold string naming what entered and what fell - so 14 entries still name the pre-fold hits, well past the plan's 'fewer than half' bar. The arm at planning-recall-fold.test.mjs:112-127 asserts >=10 entries, non-empty hits per entry, and every named id inside the returned top 5; the source-mapping arm at :87-110 asserts every document comes back under the exact `source` its fixture row states. Both pass in the 12/12 run.

truths.truth: The SUMMARY records GH-93 items 2 and 3 as open items, each naming why, with all three item-3 obstacles stated
truths.evidence: .planning/phases/5/SUMMARY.md:58-73. Item 2 names the seam-signature change and the three callers cadence-core/references/recall.md pins. Item 3 names the scope decision and all three obstacles: parseSummarySnippets returning 0 on every live reports/plan-<k>.md, REVIEW-*.md being JSON whose adjudicated rulings live in ADJUDICATION-*.json, and milestone-prune's residue walk needing extension for any new tier (RCL-07). Obstacle 2 spot-checked against reality: .planning/phases/4/REVIEW-risk_surface-plan-1.md starts `{"findings":[]}` and ADJUDICATION-risk_surface-plan-1.json sits beside it. REQUIREMENTS.md:403-409 scopes RCL-08 to 'GH-93, item 1 only', so items 2 and 3 were split out on the record rather than dropped.

truths.truth: The fold is ONE site (D-01) - a module-local helper reached only through tokenize, so index time and query time cannot drift
truths.evidence: cadence-core/bin/lib/bm25.mjs:113 `function foldSuffix(term)` is not exported; runtime check of the module's exports returns exactly ['STOPWORDS','buildIndex','search','tokenize']. tokenize is the only caller (:162), and buildIndex:178 and search:201 both reach it. `git diff cd3c3777..5d96ff44` touches no other implementation file - cadence-core/bin/planning/recall.mjs is untouched, and cadence-core/bin/planning-recall.test.mjs's only change is the single `export` keyword the plan declared.
